title: Predicting Early YouTube Engagement Relative to a Channel's Own Baseline
summary: A UC Berkeley ML/AI certificate capstone project that collects longitudinal YouTube video engagement data and trains classifiers (XGBoost and others) to predict whether a video will beat its own channel's baseline engagement within 7 days. Early model generations supplemented limited real training data with synthetic rows generated by SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer over a SingleTableMetadata schema.
